notes: Phase-1 parity gate. These encode the invariants neuro-write(journal=mia) must satisfy on every run (N=3). Deterministic checks are listed per eval; a later run_evals upgrade will execute them.

evals.name: draft-methods-section-mia-style
evals.prompt: Draft a Methods 'Experimental Setup' subsection for a generic brain-network deep-learning classification study, targeting journal = MIA. The study benchmarks a proposed model against several baselines on a resting-state fMRI connectome dataset, using AUC as the primary metric with 10-seed x 5-fold cross-validation and BH-FDR correction. Target ~600-900 words. Any statistic you were not given must be a placeholder.
evals.expected_output: MIA-style academic prose in first-person plural. Author-year citations. 'Fig. N' / 'Fig. NA' figure form. No anti-patterns. Statistics the writer was not given appear as [STAT: ...] placeholders, never invented.
checks: no anti-patterns (parenthetical numeric breakdown, inline pseudocode, magic-number enumeration, colloquialism, bullet abuse)
citation form equals the declared venue value (MIA = author-year)
no invented statistics; unverified numbers are [STAT:]/[CITE:] placeholders
